offline_verification.fixtures: Controlled providers, synthetic HTML, fake sockets/HTTP handlers, local Python subprocesses
verified_behaviors: Registry validates public URL input and web_fetch capability before budget or HTTP execution.
URL normalization is shared with the worker; DNS is checked and the public target address is pinned.
Default TLS verification and provider SNI are preserved; configured HTTP proxies use a pinned CONNECT target.
Proxy credentials stay in CONNECT and do not reach the destination GET; NO_PROXY direct routes are preserved.
No redirects, retries, JavaScript execution, login or API keys; HTTP and structural access challenges stop.
Only bounded HTML/XHTML/plain text and strict supported codecs become source material.
Raw body, normalized UTF-8 text and canonical manifest are persisted atomically; hashes and text reconstruction are checked on load.
Snapshot references cannot escape the configured root through traversal, symlink or non-regular files.
Blank pages, title-only/JavaScript shells, bad encodings and captcha structures cannot become a successful Source.
Acquisition time has a timezone; publication date remains null and source_name is only the hostname.
CLI returns a source receipt and bounded preview, facts_validated=false; it never returns Evidence, PASS or a report.
Default 60 attempts per task are reserved durably before HTTP; failures and unknown intents remain charged.
Search and fetch databases have distinct application identities; a wrong ledger is rejected without HTTP.
Completed requests replay locally with snapshot integrity checks; corruption does not trigger a replacement download.
Timeouts, cancellations and excessive output kill and reap the worker; a failed cancellation commit leaves a non-retriable unresolved intent.
Snapshot platform capability is checked before budget/network execution; unsupported platforms return a safe error.
Existing analyze/run/resume, schema, project approval and lock behavior remains covered by regression tests.
offline_verification.independent_review: Transport owner cross-reviewed tool integration and ledger/snapshot replay; no remaining blocking issue was reported.
